SAP archival also emits a structured `SAP_REPORT_POSTING_ARCHIVED` event via `SapArchivalConnectorPort`.
81: - **Stack & Boundary Justification (`project-delivery-core.mdc`)**: Implemented across the `com.example.app.governance` and `com.example.app.execution` bounded contexts in the Java 21 / Spring Boot 4.1.1 modular monolith (`app/backend/`) backed by PostgreSQL 15, Redis 7, and S3-compatible object storage (`ObjectStoragePort`). Cross-context interaction strictly traverses `ExecutionFreezePort` and `ExecutionArchivePort` (`StoredObjectMetadata` per `L-003`) without leaking internal domain entities across packages enforced by ArchUnit; `@Repository` copy constructors use package-private `jdbcTemplate()` accessors (`L-008`).

92: - **BSP (Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas) Circular 982 / 1019 (IT Risk Management & Financial Data Integrity)**: Mandates maker-checker dual control over all configuration changes and SAP ledger postings, strict runtime execution freeze protection (`0` configuration cutovers while report runs are `JOB_QUEUED` or `RUNNING`), collision-safe immutable archival (`_v2` and `_<epoch_ms>` suffixes in the S3 `archive` bucket with SHA-256 verification), preservation of valid `SUCCESS` runs when a posting ticket is rejected or cancelled, and 13-month online retention of all tickets, audit logs, and archived ledger artifacts.
93: - **Philippines Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173) & GDPR**: Requires least-privilege RBAC and object-level authorization over governance decisions and financial artifact downloads, and tamper-evident audit trails (`audit_log_entries`) recording actor identity, target ticket/run IDs, decision outcome (including `EXECUTION_FREEZE_REFUSED`), and correlation ID.
